title: Trial accounts locked one day before their trial ends
body: Three trial accounts of bench-trials-api were locked out this week on the last day of their 14-day trial: they got the "Your trial has ended" page while the trial still had hours to run. Example: account acme-trial-3, trial ending on 2026-11-20 at 18:00 UTC, locked from 2026-11-19 at 18:00 UTC. The banner still said "1 day left" that morning. Support expects access until the end date shown in the account settings.

comments.author: N0BOB
comments.text: Same on the demo account on Monday: locked at 18:00 UTC the day before its end date.

comments.author: N0ALICE
comments.text: High priority: most trials convert on their last day.
